rows.grounds: genitive plural of compound pitṛ+ādi (father and so forth), indicating the group headed by ancestors
indeclinable particle indicating inclusion or extension
noun denoting indicative reference or synecdochic inclusion

items.question: Whom else does the mention of ancestors implicitly designate in the prescribed rites?
premises: The expression pitṛ+ādīnām refers to fathers and others.
The particle api signals an inclusive extension.
The term upalakṣaṇam denotes an indicative implication.
items.inference: The reference to ancestors implicitly includes other related beings within the scope of the rites.
uncertainties: The specific beings included under 'ādīnām' are not enumerated in this verse.
items.plain_english: This is also an implication referring to the fathers and others.
